title: EMMA - New Languages Launch
description: Emma is expanding its AI-powered language engine to making spoken AI practice accessible to every learner, regardless of their mother tongue. We believe Emma belongs on the App Store's global stage and we'd love the opportunity to share that story with your users. With this update, Emma's conversational AI engine will be available to speakers of new languages, dramatically expanding our addressable audience and bringing real-time spoken practice to learners who have never had access to an AI conversation partner in their native language. Emma engages learners in natural, spoken conversations from the very first session, correcting pronunciation, adapting to each learner's level, and building genuine speaking confidence.
